title: Mubeen AI: A Specialized Arabic Language Model for Heritage Preservation and User Intent Understanding

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model outputs on heritage-focused queries (e.g., Islamic studies, Arabic poetry) and comparing intent detection performance against translation-reliant baseline models to measure cultural authenticity and mitigate English-centric translation artifacts.

Conducting custom evaluations of user intent understanding and dialectal robustness by testing the model's comprehension of various regional Arabic colloquial dialects (e.g., Saudi dialects) versus Modern Standard Arabic.

Implementing a three-phase stress testing framework (Basic Constants, Gray Areas, Stress Tests) that uses a three-tier grading system (Excellent, Good, Poor) to measure the model's adherence to Islamic doctrinal tenets, Saudi cultural norms, and political neutrality.
